title: Support `Sentry.SourceGenerators` via Visual Studio 2019 version 16.11
reason: The failure is in the Sentry .NET SDK's SourceGenerators analyzer package, which targets Microsoft.CodeAnalysis 4.3.0.0 and cannot load under Visual Studio 2019 16.11. The SDK repository is the clear owner.
notes: Build-time .NET SDK analyzer failure. Only sentry-dotnet example in the routing dataset, so holding it out leaves zero dotnet examples.

title: Snuba seems to set timestamp_ms to a max value
reason: The failure occurs when Sentry displays an event and its timeline after Snuba returns an invalid maximum timestamp. This is a Sentry event-details/issue-view handling bug; no transfer history or reliable evidence points to an SDK or separate repository.
notes: Self-hosted Snuba/ClickHouse timestamp error. Reporter-selected Product Area was Issues.

title: sentry import global silently drops all but one ProjectKey per project
reason: This is a backend defect in Sentry's global export/import relocation logic: importing multiple ProjectKeys for one project silently overwrites rows and loses DSNs. It is not an SDK or deployment-wrapper issue.
notes: Self-hosted user, but the root cause cited is in src/sentry (ProjectKey relocation import). A STAY prediction is defensible; a mismatch here is not necessarily an agent error.

title: 404 when adding a new GH repository
reason: This is a self-hosted deployment-specific failure while configuring a GitHub repository integration. Historical routing contains a closely matching confirmed transfer of a self-hosted repository-integration failure to getsentry/self-hosted. The available report lacks the exact failing endpoint or exception text, so the precise defect is unclear.
notes: Self-hosted GitHub integration 404 with almost no detail (screenshot only). Reporter-selected Product Area was Settings - Repositories.

title: Taskworker KAFKA_TOPIC_OVERRIDES Ignored
reason: This is a core Sentry taskworker/Kafka topic-resolution defect. The taskbroker producer appears to publish using the literal task topic instead of the configured real topic name, causing TOPIC_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED under prefixed Kafka ACLs and blocking ingestion/project configuration.
notes: Helm-chart deployment, but the analysis points to taskworker code in src/sentry. Ambiguous ownership.
